name: Grilled Salmon
description: Salted salmon fillet grilled until the skin crisps, the cornerstone of a traditional Japanese breakfast set.
ingredients: a handful of sliced scallion whites
a handful of fresh mitsuba, chopped
instructions: Gather and prep the short-grain rice and pork loin, measuring everything out so it is ready to go.
Heat toasted sesame oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat until warm but not smoking.
Add the minced garlic and bean sprouts, cooking gently until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the pork loin, season with wasabi paste, and cook until just done, about 10 mins.
Warm the short-grain rice alongside, turning once, until heated through and lightly toasted.
Plate the short-grain rice and spoon the cooked mixture over the top.
tips: A squeeze of citrus or a sprinkle of chives just before serving brightens up the whole plate.
Make a double batch — leftovers reheat beautifully for a quick weekday breakfast.
